Title: Senior Manager/Director of IT & Security
Location: San Mateo, CA, USA | Austin, TX, USA
Description:
**About Neurophos**
===================

The demand for new data centers and AI compute is rapidly outpacing the planet's energy capacity. Digital solutions are hitting a power wall as we approach the physical limits of traditional silicon. Conquering this bottleneck means rethinking the fundamental architecture of inference compute. The industry's current path can't meet the need, so we're taking a different approach.

Instead of traditional electronic circuits, we use silicon photonics and an active, programmable metasurface to perform matrix multiplications at the speed of light. Our optical cells are 10,000x smaller than traditional photonic components, enabling unprecedented density. By using photonics instead of electricity, our chips become more efficient as they scale. This architecture will deliver up to 100 times the energy efficiency of existing solutions while significantly improving performance for large-scale AI inference.

We’ve assembled a world-class team of industry veterans and recently raised a $110M Series A led by Gates Frontier. Participants include M12 (Microsoft’s Venture Fund), Carbon Direct Capital, Aramco Ventures, Bosch Ventures, Tectonic Ventures, Space Capital, and others.

Join us and shape the future of computing!

**Location:** Austin, TX or Sunnyvale, CA. Full-time onsite position.

**Reports To**: SVP of Engineering

**FLSA Status**: Exempt

**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Manager or Director of IT & Security to own Neurophos's IT infrastructure and information security programs across our Sunnyvale and Austin sites. Today, an external managed service provider (MSP) delivers help desk, endpoint protection, and around-the-clock security monitoring. You will own architecture, security posture, and compliance. You will direct the MSP for routine operations and decide what to bring in-house, in what order, and with what staffing.

Much of this does not exist yet. You will define it as the company grows past 150 people.

This is a builder role. You start as the senior-most IT and security voice in the company with no internal team, and you will do much of the hands-on work yourself. That includes standing up servers, writing configuration code, and running incident response. As the function grows, you will hire and lead the team that runs it.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Engineering Compute & Private Cloud**

  + Design, deploy, and operate on-premises Linux servers and clusters for EDA/CAD tools, photonic simulation, and performance modeling.
  + Run batch scheduling (SLURM, LSF, or equivalent), floating license servers (FlexNet/FlexLM), and license-aware queue policy. Forecast compute, storage, and license demand ahead of tapeouts and program milestones.
  + Operate shared storage, scratch tiering, snapshots, and backup, with restore and disaster recovery procedures tested on a set schedule.
  + Manage provisioning and configuration as code (PXE, standard images, Ansible or equivalent), and own patch and lifecycle cadence across the fleet.

  **Identity, Access & Developer Platform**

  + Own SSO and identity architecture in Okta: SAML application onboarding, SCIM provisioning, verified deprovisioning, group and role design, MFA, and privileged access.
  + Administer GitHub Enterprise, Google Workspace, Dropbox, Atlassian, and engineering and AI tooling. This covers sharing controls, retention, external-collaborator policy, license inventory, and renewals.
  + Run periodic access reviews and enforce least-privilege access to chip design repositories, process design kits (PDKs), and other high-value engineering data.

  **Network, Cloud & Sites**

  + Design and stand up wired and wireless networks at both sites, covering switching, VLANs, firewalls, VPN, and zero-trust access. Keep lab, corporate, and customer-facing environments segmented.
  + Administer public cloud (Azure preferred), covering account structure, IAM, networking, and cost visibility. Own hybrid connectivity between sites and cloud.
  + Lead the IT build-out for new office and lab space, including ISPs, circuits, and conference room A/V and video conferencing standards.

  **Security Operations & Incident Response**

  + Own SIEM/EDR, logging, and intrusion detection across endpoints, servers, and cloud, and direct the MSP's 24x7 monitoring.
  + Run vulnerability management end-to-end, covering asset scanning, prioritization, and remediation tracking with engineering teams.
  + Own the incident response runbook and serve as incident commander during security events, including forensic analysis and post-mortems.

  **Governance, Risk & Compliance**

  + Author and enforce security policy: acceptable use, data classification, network segmentation, backup and disaster recovery, and AI tool usage.
  + Lead the SOC 2 Type II program (Vanta, Drata, or similar) with engineering, the General Counsel, and external auditors.
  + Work with the General Counsel on export control (EAR/ITAR) access controls, foundry and IP-vendor data handling obligations, and customer data protection.
  + Lead customer security reviews, questionnaires, and technical due diligence with customers and investors. Assess the security risk of new SaaS and infrastructure vendors.

  **Endpoints**

  + Own the Mac, Windows, and Linux fleet: standards, imaging, MDM, encryption, patch compliance, procurement, asset tracking, and secure disposal.
  + Provide escalation support for the issues the MSP help desk cannot resolve, especially on Linux and engineering workstations.

  **MSP Governance, Budget & Team**

  + Serve as the single accountable owner of the MSP relationship: scope, SLAs, escalation paths, quarterly reviews, and cost.
  + Own the IT and security budget, report posture and roadmap to engineering leadership, and hire and develop the internal team as functions move in-house.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 10+ years in IT infrastructure, systems engineering, or security engineering, including 3+ years leading an IT or security function, team, or outsourced provider.
* Experience as the primary IT or security owner at a company under 200 people, or building a function from near zero through rapid growth.
* Hands-on Linux administration below the application layer, including storage, networking, kernel and driver troubleshooting, and fleet-scale configuration management.
* Experience operating HPC or EDA compute, including batch schedulers (SLURM, LSF, or equivalent) and floating license servers.
* Demonstrated ownership of SSO/IdP and IAM/PAM architecture (Okta strongly preferred), including SCIM provisioning and verified deprovisioning.
* Hands-on ownership of a SIEM/EDR stack, a vulnerability management program, and incident response.
* Direct experience leading at least one SOC 2 Type II audit cycle and responding to customer security questionnaires or technical due diligence.
* Practical network engineering: switching, VLANs, enterprise Wi-Fi, firewall policy, VPN, and DNS/DHCP. Able to design a site network and stand it up.
* Working proficiency in at least one major public cloud (Azure preferred) and working knowledge of export control frameworks (EAR/ITAR) as applied to technical data.
* Willingness to work onsite and travel between Sunnyvale and Austin as needed.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Experience supporting semiconductor or hardware engineering organizations, including Cadence, Synopsys, or Siemens EDA environments, foundry PDK access requirements, and lab/test networks.
* Experience moving outsourced IT or security operations in-house, including standing up an internal help desk, MDM, or endpoint program.
* Enterprise storage and data protection (NetApp, Pure, Rubrik, Veeam, or similar) with multi-site replication and disaster recovery testing.
* High-performance networking (RoCE, InfiniBand) or rack-scale hardware bring-up.
* CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or OSCP, and familiarity with NIST CSF or ISO 27001.

**What We Offer**
=================

This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in an innovative startup redefining the future of AI hardware. Work on game-changing technology at the intersection of photonics and AI as part of a collaborative, brilliant team. You’ll contribute to a platform that redefines computational performance and accelerates the future of artificial intelligence. Come help us bring this transformative technology to the world.

**Benefits**
------------

Join a team that invests in your future and your well-being. At Neurophos, we offer:

* 100% coverage of base health plan premiums for you and your dependents, plus HSA contributions.
* Unlimited PTO. No rigid vacation banks, just a focus on delivery.
* 401(k) matching and stock option opportunities to ensure our success is your success.
* Full suite of voluntary benefits, including Dental, Vision, Life, Hospital, Critical Illness, and Accident insurance.
* Personalized Benefits. Choose the plans that fit your life and take the cash back for those that don’t.

Compensation Range: $225K - $275K

Title: IT & Security Manager
Description:
**The Role**
============

In a little over a year and a half, Blank Metal has more than doubled in size. The IT, security, and compliance work that comes with that growth has been handled by whoever had time. That worked for 12 people. It doesn’t at 50, and it won’t at 100.

Our clients now hand us security addendums before kickoff, expect SOC 2 reports and annual risk questionnaires, write US-only data processing into their contracts, and audit us as a delegated entity under Medicare rules. Meanwhile our own engineers are running two laptops each, model-provider API keys are managed by hand, and nobody can tell you where every machine is.

You will own all of it, the security posture, the compliance obligations in our client agreements, the infrastructure and devices behind them, the operational side of the AI stack that runs our business, and the support team that keeps people productive.

This is a build role and a player-coach role. You’ll write the policy and fix the configuration in the same afternoon. The mandate is right-sized: we scope controls to the obligations we have and add more when a contract or an audit finding says to, not because a framework says we might need it someday.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

In your first year, we expect to see:

* **A single, current map of our obligations.** Every security and compliance commitment across our client agreements, tied to a control, an owner, and evidence.
* **A clear device and infrastructure baseline.** We know where every machine is, whose it is, and that it meets the standard.
* **A passed SOC 2 Type I with Type II underway,** with evidence that stays current instead of being rebuilt before each audit.
* **Security questionnaires and addendums answered in days instead of weeks,** with commitments we can keep.
* **A clear picture of what we spend on models and why,** and AI access that is scoped, rotated, and attributable by client and project.
* **A support function that runs without drama,** same-day account setup and access, and onboarding and offboarding that finish in hours.

**Your Five Priorities**
========================

These are the areas you will be measured on, in rough order of importance.

**1. Security posture aligned with healthcare requirements and our client agreements**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Our posture must satisfy the healthcare clients we serve today and the agreements we will sign tomorrow. You will define what “good” looks like for Blank Metal and keep it aligned as contracts evolve.

* Serve as the technical counterpart to our healthcare compliance program, translating Medicare- and HIPAA-regulated requirements into controls engineers can live with.
* Be the standing answer to client security questionnaires, security addendums, and data protection exhibits, working alongside our outside counsel so that what we commit to is what we can do.
* Write and own the policies that are missing today (access control, data retention and destruction, acceptable use, device, incident response) and make them short enough that people follow them.
* Review the tools we adopt (AI note-takers, browser extensions, SaaS) against what our client contracts allow, before someone connects them.
* Anticipate what upcoming client agreements are likely to require, so our posture is ready before the contract is.

**2. Compliance management across all client agreement obligations**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

Contracts create obligations, and obligations need owners, controls, and proof. You will run compliance as an operating discipline, not a once-a-year scramble.

* Build and maintain a register of obligations across every client agreement, including security requirements, reporting duties, audit rights, data handling, and residency terms.
* Take Blank Metal through SOC 2, choose the compliance automation platform, scope the controls to our real obligations, run the audit, and keep the evidence current.
* Support client audits of Blank Metal, including delegated-entity audits under Medicare rules, and track findings through to closure.
* Run the annual risk questionnaire cycle and keep a reusable library of accurate answers.
* Report to the COO and leadership on compliance status, open risks, and upcoming obligations.

**3. Infrastructure configured to meet security best practices**
----------------------------------------------------------------

Compliance on paper means nothing if the environment doesn’t match. You will make sure the systems we run are configured, monitored, and documented to meet the obligations we have taken on.

* Own the security configuration of the core stack (Google Workspace, 1Password, Slack, Zoom, GitHub) with sane access policies, including SSO, MFA, and least-privilege access. Be the person who says no to the fourth note-taking app.
* Build the device lifecycle we don’t have yet: procurement and vendor relationships, imaging, mobile device management, encryption and patching standards, inventory, loaners, repairs, and retirement.
* Establish and maintain cloud account standards, access patterns, and audit logging for our own environments and for client engagements that need infrastructure stood up.
* Provision secure, repeatable working environments for engineers and contractors, so a new team member is productive on day one without a security exception.
* Handle the client-issued machines and accounts that come with each engagement, within client requirements.

**4. AI and LLM operations for Blank Metal and our clients**
------------------------------------------------------------

AI is the product we deliver and the tool we work with, so how we run it matters to our clients and to our margin. You will make the AI stack accountable. You do not need to arrive as an LLM operations expert, we will teach you what is specific to model providers. What we need is the instinct to manage access, cost, and data handling carefully.

* Own the accounts, API keys, and access to our model providers and cloud environments, with rotation, scoping, and attribution by client and project.
* Stand up usage and cost observability for model spend, so leadership can see token cost by engagement, tie it to margin, and catch surprises before the invoice does.
* Enforce data residency and handling rules for AI workloads, including US-only processing, no-training clauses, and environment isolation for client data.
* Contribute to client engagements that need AI infrastructure and operations: access patterns, audit logging, and the controls clients expect. You set the pattern; delivery teams carry it.

**5. Desk support relationship and employee lifecycle**
-------------------------------------------------------

Our engineers are fast and impatient, and the support function must keep them that way. You own the outcome, working through Foundations, our desk-support function, and stepping in yourself when it matters.

* Manage the relationship with Foundations: set expectations, review performance, handle escalations, and keep the process and documentation current.
* Make onboarding and offboarding a checklist that runs in hours for employees and contractors alike, with access granted and removed correctly every time.
* Keep account setup, access, and troubleshooting a same-day thing.
* Own the hardware and software budget and get us to a standard kit, with spares on the shelf, without overspending.

**What We’re Looking For**
==========================

### **Must have**

* **5+ years running IT and security at a company under 200 people,** ideally one that handles regulated data. You’ve been the one who answered the questionnaire and sat with the auditor.
* **You have managed infrastructure to meet compliance obligations.** You have been responsible for configuring and operating real systems so that they satisfy contractual, regulatory, or audit requirements, not only writing the policy that describes them. This is the one hard requirement.
* **Experience in a SOC 2 environment.** You know what auditors look at versus what a platform dashboard says, and you have helped keep evidence current. Taking a company through SOC 2 from the start is a plus. HITRUST experience is not required.
* **You can read a security addendum** and tell a lawyer, in plain English, which clauses we can sign and which we can’t.
* **You are a right-sizer by instinct.** You scope controls to real obligations, say when something is over-built, and sequence investment on evidence rather than fear.
* **You write clearly.** Policies, questionnaire answers, and Slack replies that people read and act on.
* **You are comfortable as a player-coach.** You can manage a support partner and executive stakeholders, and you will still dig into the configuration yourself. Presenting to leadership is part of the job, and so is rolling up your sleeves.

### **Strong plus**

* Client-facing experience with AI operations, such as managing model access, usage, and cost for customers or on customer engagements.
* Exposure to HITRUST, a HIPAA program, or other regulated healthcare environments.
* Hands-on administration of a Mac fleet, MDM (Jamf, Kandji, or similar), Google Workspace, SSO and identity, and password management.
* Experience in at least one major cloud, and with the LLM provider ecosystem (API keys and quotas, gateways or proxies, reading a token bill and explaining it to a CFO).

### **We will teach**

* The specifics of AI and LLM operations. If you bring the compliance and infrastructure foundation, we will help you with the rest.

Your path may not look standard, and this role isn’t a standard hire. If your experience maps to what we need in a different way, we want to hear about it.

**Why You’ll Love It Here**
===========================

* Build AI that ships - every project ends in a live deployment, not a slide deck
* Craft meets velocity - we obsess over quality while delivering at startup speed
* Outcome-driven model - our work aligns with client success, not billable hours
* AI-native culture - you’ll work with peers who deeply understand modern AI’s potential and limits
* Real collaboration - open conversations, shared ownership, and space to bring your voice

**Compensation & Benefits**
===========================

Compensation: base salary of $155,000 to $190,000, depending on experience. This role is eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, with a guideline of 10% of base salary, based on company and individual performance. Bonuses are not guaranteed. We also offer comprehensive health coverage, 401(k) with match, flexible time off, and support for professional development.

This role is based in Minneapolis and works from our office a minimum of three days a week.

**About Blank Metal**
=====================

Blank Metal is an AI-native engineering company that partners with enterprises to deliver production AI fast. We blend strategic insight with hands-on execution, shipping high-impact systems that turn AI initiatives into measurable business results.

We’re builders, not theorists. Our team of seasoned engineers, designers, and strategists work across industries to create AI applications that get used and make a difference.

Blank Metal is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all backgrounds and perspectives. Diversity makes our work better and our team stronger.

Title: SOC Project Manager – SOC Lead (Secret Clearance)
Description:
**Who we are:**

ShorePoint is a fast-growing, industry-recognized and award-winning cybersecurity services firm focused on high-profile, high-threat public and private sector customers who demand experience and proven security models to protect their data. We embrace a “work hard, play hard” mentality and celebrate individual and company successes. We are passionate about our mission and going above and beyond to deliver for our customers, while fostering an environment that supports creativity, accountability, mission success, critical thinking and a desire to give back to our community.

**The Perks:**

As recognized members of the Cyber Elite, we work together in partnership to defend our nation’s critical infrastructure while building meaningful and exciting career development opportunities in a culture tailored to the individual’s technical and professional growth. We are committed to the belief that our team members do their best work when they are happy and well cared for. In support of this philosophy, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, major carriers for healthcare providers. Highlighted benefits include 144 hours of PTO, 11 holidays, 85% of insurance premiums covered, a 401(k), continuing education, certification maintenance and reimbursement and more.

**Who we’re looking for:**

We are seeking a **SOC Project Manager – SOC Lead (Secret Clearance)** to lead and manage all Security Operations Center functions. The SOC Lead will ensure unified service delivery across sub-task areas, provide operational direction and influence executive leadership to align security operations with enterprise objectives. The **SOC Project Manager – SOC Lead** role requires deep expertise in SOC management, incident response and hybrid on-premises/cloud environments. This is a unique opportunity to shape the growth, development and culture of an exciting and fast-growing company in the cybersecurity market.

**What you’ll be doing:**

  

* Lead a 24x7x365 SOC for unclassified environments. Ensure shift managers and escalation contacts cover every shift and on-call support is available for incident response.
* Coordinate task execution across sub-task leads to achieve enterprise-level objectives.
* Oversee the integration and coordination of on-premises and cloud-based SOC capabilities.
* Communicate effectively with executive leadership and stakeholders on SOC performance and posture.
* Ensure SOC operations adhere to the full NIST Cybersecurity Framework: Identify, Protect, Detect, Respond and Recover.
* Manage dedicated business-hours coverage commitments for specific customer offices, including staggered shift scheduling.
* Serve as, or direct, the Incident Commander for significant and widespread incidents. Responsibilities include:
  + Lead incident calls.
  + Coordinate response across all teams and task orders.
  + Manage government notifications and stakeholder communications.
  + Track after-action items through remediation.
* Direct the task order incident coordinators within each sub-task area. Ensure playbook adherence and full incident lifecycle documentation in the ticketing system.
* Oversee required reporting to federal oversight bodies, the Inspector General and law enforcement. Oversee reporting of classified spills onto unclassified systems.
* Coordinate with interagency and intelligence community partners such as CISA, the FBI and DHS.
* Execute the operational side of SOC consolidation:
  + Onboarding new customer organizations’ log sources and alerting.
  + Standardizing detection logic, escalation protocols and playbooks.
  + Transitioning onboarded organizations into steady-state operations and maintenance.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, incident response playbooks, an alert severity and triage framework, and standardized reporting templates.
* Own SOC performance metrics: mean time to detect, mean time to respond, alert volumes, false positive rates, ticket closure rates and SLA compliance. Explain any deviations and propose corrective actions.
* Build a centralized incident knowledge base and lessons-learned repository that is shared across customer organizations.
* Lead adoption of AI-enabled analytics and next-generation security automation.

  

**What you need to know:**

  

* Strong background in cybersecurity incident response across large, complex enterprise environments.
* Proven ability to align SOC functions with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
* Experience coordinating subordinate managers and technical leads to deliver cohesive operations.
* Skilled at influencing executive leadership and driving organizational adoption of SOC best practices
* Hands-on SOC leadership experience with Splunk/Splunk ES and EDR platforms such as Trellix/FireEye HX and Microsoft Defender.
* Experience with ServiceNow-based incident management, network intrusion detection (Snort/Zeek), threat intelligence platforms (MISP, STIX/TAXII) and vulnerability tools (Tenable, Qualys).
* Experience managing 24x7 shift-based workforces, including scheduling, coverage, retention and escalation structures.
* Familiarity with federal incident reporting requirements and OMB M-21-31 event logging maturity.

  

**Must have’s:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree or 3+ additional years of relevant experience in lieu of degree.
* 10+ years managing SOC operations and incident response for enterprise environments (50,000+ endpoints), including 5+ years leading hybrid on-premises/cloud SOCs with full NIST Cybersecurity Framework coverage.
* Proven ability to analyze complex requirements and translate them into clear, actionable tasks and processes through critical thinking.
* Applicants must hold and maintain an active Secret clearance.

  

**Beneficial to have the following:**

  

* Hold one or more of the following active certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Security Operations Manager (GSOM) or Certified Information Security Manager (CISM).

Title: Technical Lead
Description:

**Description**
****About the Role****
The Technical Lead owns end-to-end delivery across the organization's modern and legacy enterprise technology stacks. The role is accountable for functional delivery and equally for non-functional requirements (NFRs): performance, scalability, availability, observability, security and maintainability. You will keep business-critical systems stable and secure, lead their evolution to modern architecture, and ensure every solution aligns with enterprise architecture standards set by the Technology Architecture Group (TAG).
  
  
**Your Duties Would Include**
**Technical leadership**

* Define architecture, standards and patterns for front end, back end, data and integrations across both stacks.
* Lead the modernization roadmap, such as legacy web frameworks to modern SPA frameworks, .NET Framework to modern .NET, and monolith to microservices. Use incremental approaches and plan for coexistence.
* Make build, buy, refactor or retire decisions, and track technical debt.
* Run design reviews, spikes and proofs of concept. Turn requirements into architecture plans, estimates and task breakdowns.

**Non-functional Requirements (NFR) Ownership**

* Elicit, define, prioritize and document NFRs with stakeholders at the start of every initiative: performance, scalability, availability/SLA, resilience, capacity, security, observability, supportability and compliance.
* Convert NFRs into measurable targets (SLOs, response-time and throughput thresholds) and acceptance criteria, and design for them from the start.
* Verify NFRs before release through load, stress, soak and resilience testing, and sign off against agreed targets.
* Own capacity planning, caching, query and API optimization, and bottleneck analysis.
* Track NFR debt and include it in backlog prioritization.

**Observability and performance engineering**

* Implement and govern monitoring, logging, tracing and APM using enterprise tooling (ELK stack, Dynatrace, Azure Application Insights).
* Define standard logging, correlation ID, health-check, alerting and dashboard practices across services.
* Perform proactive performance analysis, production incident triage and root-cause analysis using APM data.
* Plan and run load and performance testing (for example JMeter, k6, Azure Load Testing, or equivalent) and report results with recommendations.

**DevSecOps and security**

* Embed security into the pipeline: static analysis (SonarQube), software composition and dependency scanning (Nexus IQ / Sonatype), and GitHub Advanced Security (code scanning, secret scanning, Dependabot).
* Own the remediation lifecycle for findings, with prioritization, ownership and SLA-based closure. Prevent quality-gate bypass.
* Coordinate with IT Security on VAPT (vulnerability assessment and penetration testing): scope, environment readiness, fix and retest, and closure evidence.
* Apply OWASP, secure coding, secrets management and hardening practices. Apply OAuth2/OIDC, JWT and role-based access, including bridging legacy authentication to modern identity.
* Keep dependencies, packages and runtime versions current, and retire unsupported components.

**Enterprise architecture alignment**

* Align solution designs with TAG principles, reference architectures, approved technology standards and governance checkpoints.
* Prepare and present design documentation for architecture review, and secure approvals and exceptions where deviations are needed.
* Ensure reuse of shared frameworks, libraries and patterns, and avoid technology sprawl.
* Contribute to the enterprise technology roadmap and standards.

**Hands-on delivery**

* Write and review production code on both stacks, and debug complex issues in legacy code with limited tests or documentation.
* Own API contracts, database changes and integrations (REST, SOAP, messaging, batch and file interfaces).
* Drive CI/CD, release management and environment strategy for on-premises (IIS, Windows services) and containerized deployments.

**Team and stakeholders**

* Mentor engineers, including upskilling legacy-focused developers on modern technologies.
* Partner with Product, BA, QA, Architecture, Security, DBA, Infrastructure and vendor teams.
* Act as the escalation point for production incidents.

**Required Skills**
**Modern stack**

* Front end - Angular (TypeScript, RxJS, state management), Ionic/Capacitor, SCSS, responsive and accessible UI
* Back end - .NET 6/8+, ASP.NET Core Web API, microservices, worker services, WebSockets/gRPC, API gateway
* Data - SQL Server (stored procedures, indexing, tuning), Redis, EF Core/Dapper
* Messaging/integration - RabbitMQ or similar brokers, event-driven design, REST
* DevOps/hosting - CI/CD (Azure DevOps), Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift
* Security - OAuth2/OIDC, Keycloak or similar IdP, JWT, OWASP

**Legacy stack**

* Front end - AngularJS 1.x, jQuery, Kendo UI, Bootstrap, Razor/MVC views, ES5 JavaScript
* Back end - .NET Framework 4.x, ASP.NET MVC / Web API 2, WCF/SOAP, Windows services, EF6 / ADO.NET
* Data - Legacy schemas, SSRS, SSIS/ETL, data warehouse jobs
* Messaging/integration - Enterprise MQ, file/batch interfaces, SOAP
* DevOps/hosting - IIS, Windows Server, MSBuild, older pipelines
* Security - Forms/Windows auth, legacy session handling, remediation of aging libraries

**NFR, Observability And Security Tooling (required)**

* Observability/APM: ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Dynatrace, Azure Application Insights.
* Performance testing: load, stress and soak testing tools, results analysis and tuning.
* DevSecOps: SonarQube, Nexus IQ / Sonatype, GitHub Advanced Security, secrets management.

Title: Manager, Architecture
Description:

**What You’ll Be Doing**

The Manager, Architecture reports to the Vice President, AI and is responsible for leading the enterprise, domain and solution architecture teams supporting Fidelity Investments Canada. The role provides technical and people leadership to ensure technology solutions are designed and implemented in alignment with enterprise architecture standards, business priorities and the firm's long-term technology strategy.

The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise, architectural judgement and people management skills. They will work closely with Business, Engineering, Data, AI and Technology teams to translate enterprise architecture direction into practical solutions, guide complex technology decisions and support modernization initiatives across the organization.

A critical part of the role is close collaboration with Fidelity International (FIL) and international architecture counterparts. The Manager will work with global teams to align architecture standards, technology roadmaps and design practices, leverage shared enterprise capabilities and contribute to common architectural direction. They will help ensure Canadian business requirements are represented in global architecture discussions while promoting consistency, reuse and collaboration across regions.

A key focus of the role is to strengthen and mature the architecture practice, establishing consistent design principles, reference architectures, governance processes and ways of working that improve the quality, efficiency and consistency of technology delivery. As emerging technologies continue to reshape enterprise systems, the Manager will also help evolve architectural practices to support modern cloud platforms, integration, generative AI and agentic AI while maintaining appropriate security, resilience and scalability.

  

* Develop and present business cases for strategic architecture-led initiatives, articulating business value, costs, benefits, risks, dependencies and architectural implications to support executive decision-making and investment prioritization.
* Provide architecture leadership throughout project delivery, ensuring key architectural decisions, risks and dependencies are actively managed and that delivered solutions remain aligned with approved target-state architectures, enterprise standards and business objectives.
* Lead the enterprise, domain and solution architecture teams, providing technical direction and oversight for the design and evolution of technology solutions across business applications, platforms and integration capabilities.
* Translate enterprise architecture strategy, standards and target-state direction into practical architectural designs, reference architectures and implementation roadmaps aligned with business and technology priorities.
* Establish and continuously improve architecture practices, design standards, governance processes and decision-making frameworks to promote consistency, reusability and effective technology delivery.
* Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership on complex initiatives, helping teams evaluate design options, resolve technical challenges and balance short-term business needs with long-term architectural sustainability.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Technology teams to support modernization initiatives, reduce technical debt, simplify system architectures and improve platform resilience, maintainability and scalability.
* Partner with Data Architecture, AI, Security and Engineering teams to ensure solutions support enterprise integration, secure data access and the adoption of emerging technologies, including generative AI and agentic AI.
* Work closely with FIL and international architecture counterparts to align technology standards, architectural patterns and roadmaps, maximize reuse of global capabilities and contribute to shared enterprise architecture direction.
* Represent Canadian architecture requirements and priorities in global discussions, fostering strong international partnerships and ensuring alignment between local delivery needs and enterprise technology strategies.
* Communicate architecture direction, design decisions and technology recommendations to business and technology stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear business implications.
* Manage, coach and develop a team of architects, establishing clear goals, accountabilities, development plans and performance expectations while fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration and continuous improvement.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Completed University Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline, or equivalent working experience.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in IT, with a strong focus on enterprise, domain or solution architecture, preferably in wealth management, financial services or another complex regulated environment.
* At least 5 years of leadership experience managing architects or senior technical professionals.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing complex enterprise technology solutions across applications, integration, cloud and technology platforms.
* Experience establishing and maturing architecture practices, design standards, governance processes and technical decision-making frameworks.
* Experience working with modern cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, enterprise integration patterns, APIs and distributed systems.
* Experience collaborating across business, engineering and technology teams on major transformation and modernization initiatives.
* Experience working in a global organization, collaborating with international architecture and technology teams, and aligning local solutions with enterprise-wide strategies and standards.
* Familiarity with generative AI, agentic AI and their implications for enterprise and solution architecture is an asset.

**The Skills You Bring**

* Strong understanding of enterprise, domain and solution architecture, with the ability to translate business and technology requirements into scalable, secure and sustainable architectural designs.
* Strong technical knowledge across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, integration architectures, APIs, distributed systems and modern technology infrastructure.
* Experience developing architecture principles, reference architectures, design standards and target-state solutions that guide technology delivery.
* Strong understanding of architecture governance, technology modernization, technical debt and technology lifecycle considerations.
* Knowledge of modern software engineering principles, cloud-native architecture and architectural patterns supporting AI-enabled applications and agentic systems.
* Strong technical judgement and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex architectural trade-offs, challenge existing approaches and provide pragmatic recommendations.
* Demonstrated ability to lead, coach and develop technical teams, establish clear expectations and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous learning.
* Strong communication, presentation and relationship-management skills, with the ability to influence business, engineering and technology stakeholders and explain complex architectural concepts in business terms.
* Strong ability to build relationships and collaborate with international counterparts, influence shared architectural decisions and balance global technology direction with local business requirements.
* Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF is an asset.

We believe exceptional work deserves exceptional recognition. That’s why we offer a **competitive compensation package** designed to support your success today—and your financial well-being tomorrow.

For this role, your total rewards include:

* **Base Salary and Discretionary Performance Bonus**: Total annual cash compensation (base salary plus target bonus) ranges from **$133,000** to **$170,000**, based on experience and qualifications.

Title: Director of Information Technology
Company: Skilled Trades Ontario / Métiers spécialisés Ontario
Description:
*Skilled Trades Ontario (STO) is a provincial Crown agency responsible for modernizing training and certification and promoting the skilled trades as a rewarding and essential career pathway. Communications and stakeholder engagement are central to STO’s mandate, ensuring clear public understanding, strong industry partnerships, and trust across Ontario.*

Skilled Trades Ontario is seeking a hands-on, strategic, and operationally focused leader to serve as its Director, Information Technology.

**DIRECTOR, INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY**

Reporting to the Chief Corporate Affairs Officer (CCAO), the
**Director, Information Technology**
will lead STO’s technology operations in a secure, cloud-first environment. The role is accountable for delivering resilient, compliant, and scalable IT services while enabling digital innovation and supporting apprenticeship, certification, and regulatory operations.

This is an important leadership role for a technology leader who can balance strategic planning with hands-on operational oversight. The Director will champion a secure-by-design and digital-by-default approach, embedding cybersecurity, privacy, risk management, and compliance into technology initiatives while fostering innovation, continuous improvement, and the responsible adoption of emerging technologies.

The role will also oversee the modernization of STO’s technology platforms and enable a modern digital workplace that supports business agility, automation, collaboration, and client-centred digital services.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Execute an IT and digital strategy aligned with STO’s organizational priorities and transformation goals
* Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on technology trends, risks, opportunities, and investment decisions
* Lead IT governance, budgeting, workforce planning, performance management, service planning, and team development
* Ensure compliance with applicable legislation, OPS I&IT directives, GO-ITS standards, organizational policies, and industry best practices
* Oversee enterprise applications, integrations, interoperability, system development lifecycles, platform services, and vendor-supported solutions
* Lead cybersecurity, IT risk management, vulnerability management, incident response, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning
* Establish data governance and data quality frameworks to support secure, compliant, and effective data management practices
* Oversee the design, implementation, modernization, and management of cloud-first environments, including Microsoft Azure
* Drive excellence in IT service management using ITIL-aligned practices across application development, infrastructure, cloud services, service desk, and end-user support
* Establish service levels, KPIs, operational metrics, reporting, and continuous improvement processes
* Manage vendor performance, support procurement and contract management, and ensure value from third-party technology services
* Assess, adopt, and govern AI-enabled tools and automation opportunities that improve productivity, service quality, and risk management

**About You**

You are an experienced IT leader with strong strategic, operational, cybersecurity, cloud, and service delivery experience. You are comfortable advising senior leaders, managing complex technology environments, leading teams, and ensuring secure, reliable, and compliant IT services in a fast-paced organization.

You bring:

* A collaborative and accountable leadership style, with the ability to build, coach, mentor, and lead a high-performing IT team
* Progressive IT leadership experience in digital, technology-driven, public sector, broader public sector, or similarly complex environments
* Experience leading cloud transformation, cybersecurity, IT operations, enterprise applications, service delivery, governance, vendor management, and modernization initiatives
* Strong knowledge of cloud platforms, particularly Microsoft Azure, with familiarity with AWS or other enterprise cloud services
* Experience with cybersecurity frameworks and best practices, including NIST, COBIT, Zero Trust, identity and access management, and data protection
* Knowledge of ITSM/ITIL processes and tools
* Experience with compliance standards and controls related to privacy, security, records, procurement, and payment environments
* Strong understanding of enterprise systems, networking, infrastructure, automation, endpoint management, monitoring, and modern workplace technologies
* Strong strategic thinking, execution, communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills
* Experience managing budgets, roadmaps, cross-functional initiatives, vendors, MSPs, and technology partners
* Post-secondary education in information technology, computer science, business administration, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant senior-level IT experience.

**Why Join Skilled Trades Ontario**

This is an opportunity to lead a broad and evolving technology function that directly supports Skilled Trades Ontario’s apprenticeship, certification, and regulatory mandate.

As Director, Information Technology, you will help shape STO’s technology strategy, strengthen cybersecurity and operational resilience, modernize systems and digital services, and support the organization’s continued transformation.

*Skilled Trades Ontario is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and accessible workplace. Accommodation is available upon request throughout the recruitment process.*

**Compensation:**
The salary range for this position is $127,859 to $179,022 commensurate with experience and qualifications. Starting salary will be based on relevant skills, experience, and internal equity.

please submit your resume by
**December 11th, 2026.**

We thank all applicants for their interest. Only those selected for further consideration will be contacted. If you have questions or require accommodations, please contact Margaret Murphy at 416-237-1500 x.234 or at margaret.murphy@hra.on.ca.

Title: Manager, Strategic Sourcing Capital Markets & Wealth Systems
Description:
Requisition ID: 272273
  
  
Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.

  

Join Scotiabank at a pivotal time of transformation, where Procurement is driving strategic value and innovation. As the Bank accelerates its adoption of AI and digital capabilities, you’ll play a key role in shaping the future of sourcing within a global organization.

  

**The Role**

  

Help Scotiabank source the technologies shaping the future of banking.

  

Scotiabank's Procurement function is at a pivotal moment – driving strategic value, commercial discipline, and innovation as the Bank accelerates its digital and AI transformation. As Manager, Strategic Sourcing – covering business line software (e.g., Capital Markets & Wealth Systems) within Technology Sourcing – you'll lead high-impact sourcing strategies across some of the Bank's most complex and fastest-evolving technology domains.

  

You'll partner with Technology, Risk, Legal, Finance, and senior business leaders to unlock enterprise value across SaaS, cloud & hyperscalers, infrastructure, software, networks. This is a role for a commercially sharp procurement leader who thrives on solving complex problems, influencing spend decisions, and delivering measurable outcomes beyond savings.

  

**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**

  

* Lead end-to-end sourcing for enterprise technology categories from opportunity assessment and market intelligence through negotiation, contracting, and benefits realization.
* Build category strategies across SaaS, cloud, software licensing, infrastructure, and telecom anchored in spend analysis, supplier capability, and market trends.
* Design and run competitive events (RFI/RFP/RFQ), including evaluation frameworks, shortlisting, negotiation strategy, and award recommendations.
* Negotiate commercially strong agreements balancing TCO, consumption vs. subscription models, service levels, flexibility, exit rights, and long-term business needs.
* Optimize the existing portfolio: identify renewal, consolidation, license rationalization, and vendor rationalization opportunities.
* Partner with Third-Party Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Finance to ensure alignment with policy, regulatory expectations, and the Bank's risk appetite.
* Manage strategic supplier relationships – performance, escalations, executive engagement, and continuous improvement.
* Track and report pipeline, benefits, milestones, and commitments with discipline and transparency.
* Act as a trusted advisor to Technology stakeholders and an escalation point on commercial and supplier matters with enterprise impact.
* Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite, risk culture and risk policies & processes should be considered/adhered to in day-to-day activities and decisions.
* Create an environment in which his/her team pursues effective and efficient operations of his/her respective areas, while ensuring the adequacy, adherence to and effectiveness of day-to-day business controls to meet obligations with respect to operational risk, regulatory compliance risk, AML/ATF risk and conduct risk, including but not limited to responsibilities under the Operational Risk Management Framework, Regulatory Compliance Risk Management Framework, AML/ATF Global Handbook and the Guidelines for Business Conduct.
* Build a high-performance environment and implements a people strategy that attracts, retains, develops and motivates their team by fostering an inclusive work environment and using a coaching mindset and behaviors; communicating vison/values/business strategy; and, managing succession and development planning for the team.

  

**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:**

  

* MBA or Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or related; CPSM, CIPS, or equivalent is preferred.
* 3–5+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, category management, or supplier management — with meaningful experience across technology categories and/or a specific business: ie: capital markets, wealth management, or retail banking.
* Deep familiarity with SaaS pricing models, cloud consumption economics, software licensing (perpetual, subscription, token-based), and MSA/SOW constructs.
* Strong commercial acumen and negotiation capability, backed by data-driven recommendations.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders (VP/SVP) and lead cross-functional teams through ambiguity.
* Hands-on with spend analytics, supplier segmentation, TCO modelling, and benchmarking .
* Understanding of third-party risk and regulatory expectations in financial services (or another regulated environment) is an asset.
* Familiarity with e-sourcing, CLM, and supplier management platforms.

  

**What’s in it for you?**

  

* A rewarding career path with diverse opportunities for professional development
* An organization committed to making a difference in our communities – for you and our customers.
* A competitive rewards program includes annual bonus, flexible vacation, personal and sick days, and comprehensive benefits that start on your first day.
* Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Allyship - We strive to create an inclusive culture where every employee is empowered to reach their fullest potential, respected for who they are, and are embraced through bias-free practices and inclusive values across Scotiabank. We embrace diversity and provide opportunities for all employees to learn, grow & participate through our various Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that span across diverse gender identities, ethnicity, race, age, ability & veterans.
* Accessibility and Workplace Accommodations - We value the unique skills and experiences every individual brings to the Bank and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.

  

Location(s): Canada : Ontario : Toronto
  
  
Scotiabank is a leading bank in the Americas. Guided by our purpose: "for every future", we help our customers, their families and their communities achieve success through a broad range of advice, products and services, including personal and commercial banking, wealth management and private banking, corporate and investment banking, and capital markets.
  
  
At Scotiabank, we value the unique skills and experiences each individual brings to the Bank, and are committed to creating and maintaining an inclusive and accessible environment for everyone. If you require accommodation (including, but not limited to, an accessible interview site, alternate format documents, ASL Interpreter, or Assistive Technology) during the recruitment and selection process, please let our Recruitment team know. Candidates must apply directly online to be considered for this role. We thank all applicants for their interest in a career at Scotiabank; however, only those candidates who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

* Building trusted client relationships and collaborating across Deloitte's cross-functional teams, including operations, technology, AI, data, industry, and delivery specialists, to deliver integrated solutions
* Coaching junior team members, contributing to team development, and supporting Deloitte's collaborative, client-focused culture

* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationship
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

Our Sales & Service offering drives global customer transformation by designing and implementing innovative sales and service experiences. We blend strategy, technology, and creativity to solve complex challenges, bringing customer strategies to life and creating new markets.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 8+ years of relevant experience in contact center operations, customer service transformation, or management consulting/advisory, including significant experience focused on contact center strategy, operations, and transformation engagements
* 4+ years of experience leading multiple project teams and workstreams simultaneously, with responsibility for delivery quality, team performance, and client outcomes
* 2+ years of experience serving Power, Utilities & Renewables clients, with an understanding of customer operations, service environments, and industry-specific business challenges
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience
* Ability to travel up to 50% on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

- Experience with contact center and customer service technologies, including CCaaS, CRM, workforce management, quality management, knowledge management, analytics, and AI-enabled service tools.
- Experience leveraging AI, automation, digital self-service, analytics, and personalization capabilities to improve customer service performance and reduce operating costs.
- Experience with Salesforce.
- Experience with Genesys, Five9, NICE, AWS, or similar cloud-based contact center and customer service platforms.
- Experience developing business cases, transformation roadmaps, operating models, performance improvement plans, and value realization frameworks.

Title: Senior Manager - Delivery Operations
Description:
**WHO WE ARE**

We’re not in the wing business. We’re in the flavor business. It’s been our mission to Serve the World Flavor since we first opened in 1994, and we’re just getting started. 1997 saw the opening of our first brand partner operated Wingstop location, and by 2002 we had served the world one billion wings. It’s flavor that defines us and has made Wingstop one of the fastest growing brands in the restaurant industry.

Above all else – our success is largely due to our people and our core values, or what we call The Wingstop Way of being entrepreneurial, service-minded, fun, and authentic. We believe having a strong people foundation centered on these collective values creates a crave-worthy culture and talented team, as well as ensures our brand is poised for accelerated growth. We all win together.

**WHAT WE’LL NEED**

**Role Summary**

The Senior Manager, Delivery Operations leads operational performance and continuous improvement across first-party and third-party delivery channels. This role drives delivery reliability, restaurant execution, and guest experience by establishing operational standards, identifying performance gaps, and implementing scalable improvements.

Working closely with Brand Partners, field teams, Delivery Service Providers (DSPs), and cross-functional partners, this leader translates operational insights into measurable improvements in restaurant efficiency and delivery performance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Delivery Performance & Reporting**

* Monitor 1P and 3P delivery performance, including service levels, cancellations, order accuracy, handoff execution, refunds, and guest issues.
* Develop actionable reporting and performance insights to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
* Establish performance reviews, escalation thresholds, and corrective-action plans with internal teams and DSPs.
* Provide monthly operational reporting to field leadership with clear recommendations and follow-up actions.
* Independently translate delivery operational priorities into actionable plans, drive DSP accountability, and influence consistent execution across the restaurant network.

**Restaurant Operations & Execution**

* Establish and improve delivery operating procedures, including order handoff verification, driver interactions, and exception handling.
* Support delivery readiness for new restaurant openings, major events, and peak-volume periods, including Big Game preparation.
* Manage operational recovery processes for paused or underperforming restaurants, including ezCater locations.
* Maintain field communications, FAQs, and operating procedures to support consistent restaurant execution.
* Partner with DSPs & Ops to improve driver engagement, pickup experience, and restaurant-driver interactions, including evaluating operational effectiveness of driver incentive initiatives.

**Issue Resolution & Guest Experience**

* Monitor delivery-related cases, Brand Partner concerns, customer support trends, and guest experience metrics.
* Coordinate resolution of recurring operational issues, including delivery failures, refund exceptions, and service disruptions..
* Partner with DSPs and internal teams to improve issue resolution and reduce repeat failures.

**Continuous Improvement & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Lead root-cause analysis, process improvements, and operational pilots to improve delivery reliability and efficiency.
* Translate operational findings into actionable improvements, training requirements, and technology enhancements.
* Partner with DSPs, Restaurant Technology, Digital Product, Guest Experience, and field leadership to resolve operational challenges.
* Track implementation, adoption, and results to ensure improvements are effective and sustainable.

**Measures of Success**

* **Delivery Reliability:** Improved service levels, order accuracy, and handoff execution; fewer cancellations and operational defects.
* **Issue Resolution:** Faster resolution of recurring issues, with clear accountability and corrective actions.
* **Restaurant Execution:** Consistent adoption of delivery standards and improved operational readiness.
* **Guest Experience:** Fewer delivery-related complaints, refunds, and repeat service failures.
* **Continuous Improvement**: Measurable, sustained improvements in delivery reliability, restaurant efficiency, and operational performance.

**WHAT YOU’LL NEED**

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience in delivery operations, restaurant operations, operational analytics, or continuous improvement, preferably within QSR or marketplace businesses.
* Strong understanding of first-party and third-party delivery operations, DSP performance management, restaurant fulfillment processes, and POS/KDS technologies.
* Proven ability to analyze performance, identify root causes, and implement sustainable operational improvements across multiple restaurant locations.
* Experience managing external partners, service-level performance, and cross-functional initiatives to drive measurable results.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and Power BI; SQL experience preferred.
* Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies, process optimization, and performance management.
* Strong business acumen, with the ability to connect operational performance to restaurant efficiency, guest experience, and financial outcomes.
* Ability to influence stakeholders and drive results in a franchise-based, cross-functional environment.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and project management skills.

**WHO YOU ARE**

No job is too small. You recognize that the real work happens in the restaurants, and everything we do should support their success. You stay humble, roll up your sleeves, and always look for ways to help. You learn from others and contribute wherever you can.

You care deeply about doing great work and driving results. You’re curious, ask questions, and seek out opportunities to improve. You don’t just point out problems—you bring solutions, ideas, and perspectives that move the team forward.

You take full responsibility for your work and see things through to completion. You aren’t afraid to fail because you know that failure is a part of learning and growth. You take action, move fast, and keep pushing forward.

You lead with empathy, respect, and emotional intelligence. You collaborate effectively, fostering a culture of trust and constructive feedback. You understand the importance of teamwork and ensure that your actions build others up rather than break them down.

You push yourself and others to be better. You embrace healthy conflict, knowing that great ideas and strong teams emerge from honest, constructive conversations. You believe that leaders create leaders and are committed to fostering a culture of growth, challenge, and continuous improvement.

* One paid volunteer day of your choice

**FUN IS THE BEST FLAVOR:**

We are looking for a leader to re-engineer Mercans' managed-payroll operation into a country-agnostic, offshore-first, product-led model — one where country knowledge lives in the platform and a central compliance center of excellence rather than in individuals, where automation and AI remove manual work, and where customers own and control their data and execution through self-service. The goal is a standardized run-cycle where any consultant can run any payroll anywhere, and an operation that partners with clients strategically rather than just processing their payroll.

**This is a hands-on, grass-roots role.**
You will learn the product deeply, get close to clients and the operation, resolve issues at the grass-root level, and lead by doing rather than delegating. You will report initially to the Group CEO and, in due course, to the Business Unit Managing Director.

**What You'll Own**

Your mission is to deliver a new operating model. You will:

1. **Build a country-agnostic operating model**
   — codify country rules and knowledge into the platform and a central compliance center of excellence, with one standardized run-cycle and no single-expert dependency.
2. **Build an offshore-first, fungible workforce**
   — cross-trained and “2-deep” in every country, delivering high productivity at scale.
3. **Put customers in control**
   — self-service and data ownership through the product, and a strategic, advisory relationship instead of support ping-pong.
4. **Automate relentlessly**
   — automate manual and country-variable steps, deploy AI as a knowledge layer, and use anomaly detection for visibility and quality.
5. **Run a leaner, focused delivery core**
   with disciplined quality and performance governance.
6. **Migrate all clients onto a single platform**
   to eliminate manual processes and enable people to move freely between clients.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Country-Agnostic, Platform-Led Operating Model**

* Relocate country knowledge out of individuals into the platform (codified rules, wage-type catalogs, formulas) and a central compliance center of excellence.
* Establish one standardized, country-agnostic run-cycle so any consultant can run any payroll anywhere, eliminating single-expert dependency.
* Migrate all clients onto a single platform to remove manual processes and enable free movement of people between clients.

**Offshore-First, Fungible Workforce**

* Make offshore the primary delivery model; cross-train so no client depends on a single person and every country is “2-deep.”
* Drive consultant productivity toward best-in-class levels at scale.

**Customer Experience, Self-Service & Data Ownership**

* Give customers ownership and control of their data, timelines, and execution through self-service.
* Shift client engagement from tactical execution to a strategic, advisory partnership, and drive changes to customer data toward zero for compliance.

**Automation & AI**

* Automate every manual and country-variable step (statutory reports, integrations, bank files, and more) using a deliberate map → automate → internalize approach.
* Deploy AI as an on-demand knowledge layer and anomaly-detection tooling for visibility and quality.

**Scope, Quality & Performance Governance**

* Run a leaner, focused managed-payroll delivery core with clear scope discipline.
* Stand up a business-assurance / QA function with process audits, SLA monitoring, a regional RAG on stability, scalability, and resilience, and a disciplined review, coaching, and appraisal cadence.

**How You'll Work — Hands-On & Grass-Roots**

* Learn the product and the operation first-hand, stay close to clients, and resolve issues at root cause rather than delegating.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Hands-on and grass-roots by nature —**
  you learn the product deeply, get close to clients and operations, and resolve issues at root-cause level rather than delegating.
* **Operating-model transformation —**
  proven design and delivery of a standardized, offshore-first, platform-led payroll/operations model that removes country-knowledge and single-expert dependency.
* **Automation and AI expertise —**
  process standardization, product adoption, automation, and applied AI (including agentic AI) to eliminate manual work.
* **A customer-advisory and self-service orientation —**
  you move clients to self-service and strategic partnership, delivering an unparalleled client experience.
* **Operations leadership at scale —**
  10+ years in global payroll outsourcing or SaaS operations, including multi-regional and offshore delivery leadership.
* **Technology and compliance fluency —**
  deep understanding of payroll/SaaS platforms, config-driven operations, integrations, and multi-country payroll compliance.
* **Leadership and resilience —**
  proven ability to coach teams, influence stakeholders at all levels, and stay composed under pressure.
* **Education —**
  Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations Management, or a related field; MBA preferred.

**What Success Looks Like**

In your first 12–18 months, success means:

* A standardized, country-agnostic run-cycle is live — any consultant can run any payroll anywhere, with no single-expert dependency.
* Delivery is offshore-first and “2-deep,” with strong consultant productivity.
* Customers self-serve and own their data, and the relationship is strategic and advisory — with excellent CSAT and retention.
* Manual and country-variable steps are automated, and clients are migrated onto a single platform.
* The delivery core is leaner and well-governed, with clean compliance and strong quality assurance.

**Why Mercans**

* Lead a genuine transformation of a global operation at the center of how the world pays its people.
* A real mandate to re-engineer the model — this is a role for a builder, not a caretaker.
* A global, fast-moving, technology-led environment with a direct line to senior leadership.
* Competitive compensation aligned to the seniority and impact of the role.

**How to Apply**

To apply, please submit your CV and a short note outlining an operation you have transformed through the Mercans careers portal. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

Title: Business Continuity Manager
Description:
**Position Summary**

The Business Continuity Manager is a key role responsible for overseeing the development and implementation of business continuity plans to ensure the company’s operations can withstand and recover from unexpected disruptions.

**What will your job entail?**

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Assess the potential impact of disruptions on critical business processes, identifying dependencies, recovery time objectives (RTOs), and resource requirements.
* Identify and evaluate risks that could affect business operations, including natural disasters, cyber threats, supply chain disruptions, and other emergencies. Develop strategies to mitigate these risks.
* Create and maintain comprehensive emergency response plans that outline procedures for handling crises, evacuations, communication, and resource allocation during disruptions.
* Develop and update business continuity plans (BCPs) that address various scenarios, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and compliance requirements.
* Coordinate regular testing and exercises to validate BCP effectiveness. Conduct tabletop simulations, functional exercises, and full-scale drills to assess readiness.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams, including IT, facilities, legal, and senior management, to ensure alignment and buy-in for business continuity efforts.
* Provide training sessions to employees on BCPs, emergency procedures, and their roles during disruptions. Foster a culture of preparedness and awareness.
* Regularly review and enhance business continuity strategies based on lessons learned, industry best practices, and changes in the business environment.  
    
  **Work Experience and Education:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management or Business with 6+ years of experience
* 3+ years of supervisor or lead experience.
* Insurance industry experience preferred

**Licenses &** **Certifications:**

Certified Business Continuity Professional (CBCP) or ISO 22301 Lead Implementer or Project Management Professional (PMP) is preferred

**Technical/Functional Skills:**

* Risk assessment and risk management: Identifies, analyzes, and prioritizes operational, technology, third-party, and environmental risks, and develops practical risk mitigation strategies aligned with enterprise risk management frameworks.
* Business impact analysis (BIA): Conducts BIAs to determine critical processes, dependencies, recovery time objectives (RTOs), recovery point objectives (RPOs), maximum tolerable downtime, and financial and operational impacts of disruption.
* Business continuity and resilience planning: Develops and maintains business continuity plans, crisis management and emergency response plans, and recovery strategies in line with ISO 22301, DRI International, or Business Continuity Institute (BCI) standards and practices.
* Strategic planning: Builds multi-year business continuity program roadmaps, defines program metrics, and aligns continuity priorities with business strategy and operational resilience goals.
* IT disaster recovery and technology resilience: Partners with IT and information security to align application recovery priorities, system dependencies, and disaster recovery capabilities with business recovery requirements.
* Third-party and vendor continuity: Evaluates the resilience of critical vendors, service providers, and delegated authority partners, including review of vendor continuity plans and recovery capabilities.
* Business continuity software administration: Administers and configures business continuity planning platforms to manage plans, BIAs, contact data, assessments, and reporting.
* Mass notification and threat intelligence administration: Manages emergency notification systems, including contact data quality, message templates, and delivery testing, and monitors threat intelligence sources to provide timely alerts on severe weather, safety, and other events affecting employees and operations.
* Exercise design and facilitation: Designs, facilitates, and documents tabletop, functional, and full-scale exercises, and tracks resulting corrective actions through to completion.
* Data analysis and reporting: Analyzes plan, exercise, and incident data to draw clear conclusions, and produces dashboards and metrics that inform decisions by leadership.
* Presentation development and delivery: Develops and delivers clear, concise presentations and training materials to audiences ranging from front-line employees to senior executives.

**Functional Requirements:**

* Own the enterprise business continuity program lifecycle, including governance, policy and standards, annual plan review and approval cycles, and program maintenance across all business units.
* Lead and maintain the BIA process for all business units, and ensure results drive recovery strategies, resource requirements, and plan content.
* Maintain business continuity, crisis management, and emergency response plans, and verify that plan owners review and update them at least annually and after significant organizational or operational change.
* Plan and execute an annual schedule of exercises and tests, and document results, gaps, and corrective actions with assigned owners and due dates.
* Coordinate the organization’s response during incidents and disruptions, including activating plans, convening the crisis management team, and supporting internal and external communications.
* Conduct post-incident and post-exercise reviews, and incorporate lessons learned into plans, training, and program improvements.
* Ensure the program meets applicable insurance regulatory, contractual, and audit requirements, such as state department of insurance expectations, NAIC guidance, and client or carrier due diligence requests.
* Support client, carrier, regulator, and auditor inquiries by providing business continuity attestations, evidence, and documentation.
* Report on program status, risks, exercise results, and key metrics to senior leadership, executive committees, and the board as required.
* Manage the business continuity planning and mass notification platforms, including user access, data accuracy, and regular testing.
* Develop and deliver business continuity awareness and training programs for employees, plan owners, and crisis management team members.
* Supervise or lead business continuity staff, contractors, and a network of plan owners and coordinators, setting priorities and providing direction and coaching.

**Behavioral Skills:**

* Effective communication: Communicates clearly and calmly in writing and verbally, tailoring messages for executives, technical teams, and employees, especially during high-pressure incidents.
* Interpersonal skills and influence: Builds trusted relationships and gains buy-in across departments, business units, and levels of leadership without relying on direct authority.
* Attention to detail: Maintains accurate, complete, and audit-ready plans, records, and contact data.
* Decision making: Makes timely, well-informed decisions with incomplete information and balances risk, cost, and operational impact.
* Problem-solving: Applies structured, analytical thinking to resolve complex issues and develop practical solutions.
* Leadership and accountability: Leads by example, follows through on commitments, and holds teams and plan owners accountable for deliverables.
* Continuous learning: Stays current on emerging threats, regulatory changes, and industry best practices, and applies new knowledge to improve the program.
* Emotional intelligence: Remains composed under pressure, shows empathy toward affected employees, and adapts communication style to different audiences and situations

* Strategic IDN Account Development. Identify and prioritize the largest IDNs by bed count, facility footprint, capital budgets and market opportunity; develop comprehensive strategic account plans; map organizational structures, decision-makers, purchasing authority and clinical leadership; build relationships at corporate headquarters and individual facilities.
* C-Suite and Executive Relationship Management. Build relationships with CEOs, COOs, CFOs, Chief Nursing Officers and system-level supply chain executives; position Span-America as a strategic healthcare partner rather than a transactional supplier; conduct executive business reviews and planning meetings; gain access to system-wide capital equipment and clinical standardization initiatives.

* Capital Equipment and Replacement Strategies. Identify targets to execute replacement opportunities for capital equipment while developing multi-year agreements focusing on capital replacement programs and lifecycle programs.

Coordinate product specialists, clinical education, customer service, operations and contracting; work with Savaria Patient Care leadership on integrated account strategies; ensure successful product trials, conversions, implementations and training; serve as commercial leader and executive contact for enterprise accounts.
